title: 2001 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: For the game show Who Wants To Be a Millionaire? the dollar values of each question are shown in the following table (where \(\text{K}=1000\)). \[ \begin{array}{ccccc} \boldsymbol{\#} & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \boldsymbol{\$} & 100 & 200 & 300 \end{array} \]\[ \begin{array}{cccccc} 4 & 5 & 6 & 7 & 8 \\ 500 & 1\text{K} & 2\text{K} & 4\text{K} & 8\text{K} \end{array} \] \[ \begin{array}{ccccc} 9 & 10 & 11 & 12 \\ 16\text{K} & 32\text{K} & 64\text{K} & 125\text{K} \end{array} \] \[ \begin{array}{ccc} 13 & 14 & 15 \\ 250\text{K} & 500\text{K} & 1000\text{K} \end{array} \] Between which two questions is the percent increase of the value the smallest?

solutions.text:
Most of the listed increases are doublings, which are \(100\%\) increases.

The exceptions among the answer choices are from \(2\) to \(3\), from \(3\) to \(4\), and from \(11\) to \(12\).

These percent increases are \(\dfrac{300-200}{200}=50\%\), \(\dfrac{500-300}{300}=66\dfrac23\%\), and \(\dfrac{125000-64000}{64000}\), which is about \(95\%\).

The smallest is from question \(2\) to question \(3\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Compare the few increases that are not exactly \(100\%\)
